name: Monmusu House da! ~Bakunyuu Mamono Musume no Oppai Gyaku Rape~
original_name: もんむすハウスだ!～爆乳魔物娘のおっぱい逆レイプ～
source:
The protagonist was a peaceful ordinary guy.
He was walking home peacefully and ordinarily like he always did, when suddenly he blacked out.
When he woke up again it was late at night. He was standing in the middle of the forest.
He had no idea how to get home, but there was a huge mansion.
It was a sanctuary for big breasted she-monsters...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ118664.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个平和的普通人。
他像往常一样平静地走回家，突然眼前一黑。
当他再次醒来时，已是深夜了。他站在森林中央。
他不知道怎么回家，但那里有一座巨大的豪宅。
那是大胸女妖的庇护所……
